theme.description: Elegant luxury and corporate dark theme. Cinematic, moody, deeply textured, establishing a premium, high-end trust. The vibe is 'Old Money Tech' meeting modern booking efficiency.

background.description: Deep Slate-900. Never use pure black. This provides a structural, moody canvas.

surface.description: Used for cards, modals, and the slide-over cart panel. It creates depth against the slate-900 base.

surface_glass.description: Used ONLY for the sticky header and top navigation. CRITICAL: Never use a fully transparent header over the hero image.

accent.description: Amber/Gold. Used for primary CTAs, the 'Sapa-Panti Sosial' brand name, active states, and luxurious accents. Use sparingly to maintain the premium feel.

text_muted.description: For body text, table data, and secondary information.

brand_and_headings.weight_strategy: font-bold to font-black for headings, font-medium for brand name.
brand_and_headings.brand_specific: The Brand 'Sapa-Panti Sosial' must be exactly 32px (text-3xl) and use the Amber color (#f59e0b).

body_and_ui.weight_strategy: font-normal for body, font-medium for labels and table headers.

typography.instruction: Do NOT use Inter. Enforce the serif/sans pairing explicitly. Headings must have tight tracking.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-slate-700 or border-white/10 for subtle separation on cards and modals.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Deep ambient shadows: shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]. Do not use light shadows in dark mode.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Interactive elements must transition cleanly. Buttons: hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg transition-transform duration-300. Links: hover:text-amber-400 transition-colors.
visual_enhancers.overlays: Hero image MUST have a bg-slate-900/60 overlay to ensure the Amber and White text pops.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add subtle CSS noise or grain if possible to the main background to avoid 'digital flatness'.

layouts_and_grids.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-12, py-20 to let the luxury breathe. Cramped UI looks cheap.
layouts_and_grids.hero: Full height (min-h-[90vh]) or standard large hero (min-h-[70vh]). Center-aligned text for cinematic feel, with Amber Brand Name prominent.
layouts_and_grids.room_catalogue: The 'Bento' or structured grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-8. Images must have aspect-video or aspect-[4/5] object-cover.
layouts_and_grids.admin_dashboard: High-density grid for metrics. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 for top metric cards. Tables must stretch full width overflow-x-auto.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or crisp slight-radius (rounded-md). Primary: bg-amber-500 text-slate-900 hover:bg-amber-400. Secondary: border border-slate-600 text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-800.
components.modals: Room Detail Modal & Admin Login Modal must use Shadcn Dialog. Backdrop blur is mandatory (backdrop-blur-sm bg-black/80). Dialog content bg-slate-800.
components.slide_over_cart: Use Shadcn Sheet component. Slide from right. bg-slate-900 border-l border-slate-800.
components.cards: Room Cards: bg-slate-800 border-none overflow-hidden group. Image zooms on hover (group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-700 ease-out).
components.inputs: Shadcn Inputs. bg-slate-900 border-slate-700 focus:border-amber-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500 text-slate-100.
components.toast: Use Sonner for top-right notifications. Dark theme config.
components.table: Shadcn Table for bookings. Hover effects on rows (hover:bg-slate-800/50). Status badges: Amber for Pending, Emerald for Confirmed.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case. Examples: data-testid='room-card-meeting', data-testid='checkout-submit-btn', data-testid='admin-login-input', data-testid='status-dropdown'.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure Amber text on Slate background meets at least AA standards. Use text-amber-500 on slate-900, text-amber-600 on lighter backgrounds if needed.
accessibility_and_testing.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Animations must be purposeful, not distracting.

hero_ballroom.description: Elegant ballroom setup with crystal candelabras and luxurious decorations, perfect for a grand celebration.
hero_ballroom.category: Hero Section Background / Main Brand Image

room_meeting.description: A modern corporate meeting room with a large table and chairs.

room_vip.description: Luxurious dark room with green leather chesterfield sofa, matching the slate dark mode vibe perfectly.

room_outdoor.description: Decorated wooden barn with glowing string lights at twilight.

qris_payment.description: High-resolution close-up of a smartphone displaying a QR code on its screen.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn UI components extensively but heavily customize them via Tailwind to match the Slate/Amber luxury theme.
Do NOT add a global transition: all to CSS. Apply transitions specifically to hover states via Tailwind.
Do NOT use HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn Select and Calendar/Popover.
Ensure 'Sapa-Panti Sosial' is styled as text-amber-500 text-3xl font-serif.
In the Admin Dashboard, construct metrics cards and the bookings table cleanly without heavy card borders; use subtle background variations (bg-slate-800).
The header must NOT be fully transparent if content scrolls under it. Use bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-xl.
Use Lucide-React for all icons (e.g., DoorOpen, Calendar, MapPin, Users, Settings, LayoutDashboard, CreditCard, CheckCircle).
Always add data-testid to your interactive components to ensure tests pass.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx (or tsx).
